/* ============================================================
   Widen the ENTIRE Mintlify column (header + body + footer together)
   on pages that use .bd-landing. Do NOT full-bleed just the body —
   that misaligns header and footer.

   Mintlify caps the column at ~1152px via an anonymous ancestor div
   and `.prose` at ~65ch on the body. We override both via :has()
   selectors that only match when .bd-landing is present deep inside.
   ============================================================ */

/* The anonymous 1152px ancestor: direct child of the scroll-mt
   wrapper, contains the flex-row-reverse grid. */
div:has(> div.flex.flex-row-reverse > div.relative.grow > div.mdx-content > .bd-landing) {
  max-width: none !important;
}

/* The prose body max-width */
div.mdx-content:has(> .bd-landing),
div.prose:has(> .bd-landing) {
  max-width: none !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}

/* Hide Mintlify's auto-rendered page header (breadcrumb + h1 title +
   description + "Copy page" button) — we render our own hero with
   those elements inside .bd-landing. */
div:has(> div.mdx-content > .bd-landing) > header.relative.leading-none,
div:has(> div.mdx-content > .bd-landing) > header {
  display: none !important;
}

.bd-landing {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
}

/* ============================================================
   Bright Data branded landing page styles
   Scoped to .bd-landing wrapper - apply only on hub pages
   ============================================================ */

.bd-landing {
  --bd-primary: #4180f9;
  --bd-primary-tint: rgba(65, 128, 249, 0.08);
  --bd-primary-border: rgba(65, 128, 249, 0.25);
}

/* Inner content column. Sits inside .bd-landing which now inherits
   Mintlify's natural column width (widened via the :has() overrides
   above). No horizontal padding — header and footer share the same
   inline edges, so we let the content align with them naturally. */
.bd-page {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 0 3rem;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Hero: two-column grid on desktop, stacks on mobile */
.bd-hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 2rem;
  align-items: start;
  margin: 0.5rem 0 1.25rem;
}

@media (min-width: 960px) {
  .bd-hero {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 3rem;
  }
}

.bd-hero-copy {
  min-width: 0;
}

/* Hero visual: Stripe-style illustration in the right column.
   Capped so it doesn't dominate the row height over the copy column. */
.bd-hero-image {
  min-width: 0;
  max-width: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.bd-hero-image img {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 480px;
  max-height: 360px;
  height: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
  display: block;
}

.bd-eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--bd-primary);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.bd-hero-copy .bd-headline,
h1.bd-headline {
  font-size: 2.75rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  line-height: 1.05 !important;
  margin: 0 0 1rem !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em !important;
  display: block !important;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

/* Hide the zero-width space / anchor link marker Mintlify injects
   at the start of headings inside our hero. */
.bd-hero-copy .bd-headline > a,
.bd-hero-copy .bd-headline::before {
  display: none !important;
}

.bd-subhead {
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: #475569;
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
  max-width: 38rem;
}

.dark .bd-subhead {
  color: #cbd5e1;
}

/* Dual-CTA row: primary solid + secondary outline */
.bd-cta-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin: 1.25rem 0 0;
}

.bd-cta-row a.bd-cta-primary,
.bd-cta-row a.bd-cta-secondary {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}

.bd-cta-row a.bd-cta-primary {
  background: var(--bd-primary);
  color: #fff !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd-primary);
}

.bd-cta-row a.bd-cta-primary:hover {
  background: #2f6ce8;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(65, 128, 249, 0.25);
}

.bd-cta-row a.bd-cta-secondary {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--bd-primary) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--bd-primary-border);
}

.bd-cta-row a.bd-cta-secondary:hover {
  background: var(--bd-primary-tint);
  border-color: var(--bd-primary);
}

/* Thin callout banner below hero (Stripe-style). */
.bd-callout {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.875rem 1.25rem;
  margin: 0 0 2rem;
  background: var(--bd-primary-tint);
  border: 1px solid var(--bd-primary-border);
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.bd-callout a {
  color: var(--bd-primary) !important;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.bd-callout-icon {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1;
}

/* "Most popular" pill badge. */
.bd-pill {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem;
  background: var(--bd-primary);
  color: #fff;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.bd-group-label {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

/* Sub-group headings inside "Popular scrapers" (Social, AI & Search, etc.) */
.bd-page h3.bd-group-heading {
  font-size: 0.8125rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: #64748b !important;
  margin-top: 2.5rem !important;
  margin-bottom: 1rem !important;
  padding-left: 0 !important;
}

.dark .bd-page h3.bd-group-heading {
  color: #94a3b8 !important;
}

.bd-page h3.bd-group-heading::before {
  display: none !important;
  content: none !important;
}

/* Branded cards - thicker borders, accent on hover */
.bd-landing a[href]:has(> div),
.bd-landing [class*="card"] {
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
}

.bd-landing a[href]:has(> div):hover,
.bd-landing [class*="card"]:hover {
  border-color: var(--bd-primary) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(65, 128, 249, 0.12) !important;
}

/* Color the icons in branded cards */
.bd-landing svg[class*="icon"],
.bd-landing [class*="card"] svg {
  color: var(--bd-primary) !important;
}

/* Section headers — scoped to direct children of .bd-page so they do
   NOT leak into Card titles, which render nested h2/h3-like elements. */
.bd-page > h2 {
  font-size: 1.75rem !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  margin-top: 4rem !important;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem !important;
  line-height: 1.2 !important;
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 1rem;
  color: inherit;
}

.bd-page > h2::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0.25rem;
  bottom: 0.25rem;
  width: 4px;
  background: var(--bd-primary);
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.bd-page > h2 + p,
.bd-page > h3 + p {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem !important;
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.dark .bd-page > h2 + p,
.dark .bd-page > h3 + p {
  color: #94a3b8;
}

/* Third-level headings (e.g. "Request modes", "Delivery options") */
.bd-page > h3 {
  font-size: 1.125rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  margin-top: 2rem !important;
  margin-bottom: 1rem !important;
  color: inherit;

/* Paragraphs in the landing body (descriptions under h2) */
.bd-page > p {
  font-size: 1rem;

  margin: 0 0 1.5rem;

div.mt-12 > li > div {

<span data-as="p">When creating an API key, you can assign one of five permission levels to control access and ensure security based on user roles or use cases. <a class="link" href="/api-reference/authentication#understanding-api-key-permissions">Learn more about user roles here</a>.</span>
<h4 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="what-permissions-level-does-an-api-key-have"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#what-permissions-level-does-an-api-key-have" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">What permissions level does an API key have?</span></h4>
<span data-as="p">There are 5 types of permissions to choose from to control API key access:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Admin:</strong> Grants full access to the account, including all Billing, Financial, product settings and configurations.</li>
<li><strong>Finance:</strong> Allows access to Billing and Financial pages only.</li>
<li><strong>Ops:</strong> Allows access to proxy/API configurations but restricts Billing access.</li>
<li><strong>Limit:</strong> Permits management of proxy passwords and IP allowlists/denylists.</li>
<li><strong>User:</strong> Enables API usage on the proxy/API level without access to Billing or product configuration pages.</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">When creating an API key, you can setup its expiration date. Requests authenticating with this key past the expiration date will be denied.</span>
<span data-as="p">You can setup the expiration date as <code>unlimited</code> - although this is possible, we strongly recommend to setup an expiration date.</span>
<span data-as="p">Consult your organization’s information or data security officer for instructions.</span>

<span data-as="p">This parameter is made up of three elements combined into a single string:</span>
<ol>
<li><code>ACCOUNT_ID</code> - your unique customer identifier.</li>
<li><code>PROXY_NAME</code> - the name you gave your proxy or API (e.g., <code>web_unlocker1</code>, <code>datacenter_proxy1</code>).</li>
<li><code>PROXY_PASSWORD</code> - the password shown in your Access Details.</li>
</ol>
<span data-as="p">Together, they form the complete proxy-user value.</span>

<ul>
<li>All parameters are case sensitive.</li>
<li>The string must be consecutive without spaces.</li>
<li><code>-</code> (dash/minus sign) separates the username substrings, and <code>:</code> (colon) separates the username from the password.</li>
</ul>

  }

  return null; // no match found
}

// ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function run({ docsRoot = DOCS_ROOT, includeCN: incCN = includeCN, dryRun: dry = dryRun } = {}) {
  const allFiles = collectMdx(docsRoot)
    .filter(f => incCN || !f.includes('/cn/'))
    .sort();

  const slugIndex = buildSlugIndex(allFiles, docsRoot);

  const fixed = [];
  const skipped = [];

  for (const file of allFiles) {
    let content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
    const rel = path.relative(docsRoot, file);
    const links = extractLinks(content);
    let fileModified = false;

    for (const { link } of links) {
      if (resolveLink(link, docsRoot)) continue; // not broken

      const anchor = link.includes('#') ? link.slice(link.indexOf('#')) : '';
      const fix = findFix(link, slugIndex, allFiles, file);

      if (fix) {
        const fixWithAnchor = fix + anchor;
        // Replace all occurrences of this exact broken link in the file
        const hrefPattern = new RegExp(`href="${link.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')}"`, 'g');
        const mdPattern = new RegExp(`\\]\\(${link.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')}`, 'g');
        const newContent = content
          .replace(hrefPattern, `href="${fixWithAnchor}"`)
          .replace(mdPattern, `](${fixWithAnchor}`);

        if (newContent !== content) {
          content = newContent;
          fileModified = true;
          fixed.push({ file: rel, from: link, to: fixWithAnchor });
        }
      } else {
        skipped.push({ file: rel, link, reason: 'no unique match found' });
      }
    }

    if (fileModified && !dry) {
      fs.writeFileSync(file, content, 'utf8');
    }
  }

  return { fixed, skipped, dryRun: dry };
}

if (require.main === module) {
  const summary = run();
  console.log(JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2));

  if (summary.fixed.length > 0) {
    process.stderr.write(`\nFixed ${summary.fixed.length} link(s) across ${[...new Set(summary.fixed.map(f => f.file))].length} file(s).\n`);
  }
  if (summary.skipped.length > 0) {
    process.stderr.write(`Skipped ${summary.skipped.length} link(s) — could not determine correct target.\n`);
  }
}

module.exports = { findFix, buildSlugIndex, isCN, run, collectMdx, extractLinks, resolveLink };

  const allFiles = [

  ];
  const idx = buildSlugIndex(allFiles, root);

  const sourceFile = path.join(root, 'en-page.mdx');
  const fix = findFix('/api-reference/widget', idx, allFiles, sourceFile);

  assert.equal(fix, null, 'EN source must not auto-link to a /cn/ target');
});

test('findFix refuses to cross the CN→EN language boundary', () => {
  const { root, write } = makeFixture();
  write('api-reference/widget.mdx', '---\ntitle: Widget\n---\n');
  write('cn/page.mdx', '---\ntitle: CN\n---\n[link](/cn/api-reference/widget)\n');

  const allFiles = [
    path.join(root, 'api-reference/widget.mdx'),

  ];
  const idx = buildSlugIndex(allFiles, root);

  const sourceFile = path.join(root, 'cn/page.mdx');
  const fix = findFix('/cn/api-reference/widget', idx, allFiles, sourceFile);

  assert.equal(fix, null, 'CN source must not auto-link to an EN target');
});

  write('cn/api-reference/widget.mdx', '');
  write('en-page.mdx', '');
  write('cn/cn-page.mdx', '');

  const allFiles = [
    path.join(root, 'api-reference/widget.mdx'),
    path.join(root, 'cn/api-reference/widget.mdx'),
    path.join(root, 'en-page.mdx'),
    path.join(root, 'cn/cn-page.mdx'),
  ];
  const idx = buildSlugIndex(allFiles, root);

  const enFix = findFix('/widget', idx, allFiles, path.join(root, 'en-page.mdx'));
  assert.equal(enFix, '/api-reference/widget', 'EN source should match EN target');

  write(
